card.name: Abraham and Isaac story, plus testes
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", "of" or a space before a number, in passages about the binding of Isaac and Abraham. It also fires in text on undescended testes, before time or count figures.

modes.label: Biblical patriarchs
modes.description: The word "the" or "of" right before a description of Isaac or Abraham, as in the Akedah, the binding of Isaac.
modes.example: The first shows the Akedah,<< the>> binding of Isaac on the altar.

modes.label: Undescended testes
modes.description: A space or small word before a number or timing figure in text on undescended testes in boys.
modes.example: Most testes descend on their own within about<< >>6 months.

card.writes: It promotes biblical name tokens such as Isaac, Abram and Ibrahim, so it adds a likely patriarch name next.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a name like Isaac, and oddly also in text about undescended testes in boys.
